Is the Cu Chi Tunnels + Mekong Delta combo day tour worth it? I've done both separately and together. For 3-5 day trips: yes ($40-50, 10-12 hrs, 3-4 hrs driving). For a full week: do them separately. Cu Chi gets rushed on the combo — history people, you've been warned. Full breakdown →

The Can Tho team visited farmers in Dong Tien Cooperative, which manages 900 hectares of clam farming. With yields declining in recent years due to environmental variability, the cooperative has invested in a 24-hectare hatchery with nursery tanks, grow-out ponds and water treatment infrastructure.
